tasks.title: Add WorkState, editStateOf and withState to core/document
tasks.dod: Vitest proves withState(work, editStateOf(other)) restores the very Geometry, Adjustments and Drawing layer objects (toBe) and the state's revision, while keeping id, Original, source and cleanRevision

tasks.title: Add core/history: EditHistory with createHistory, record, undo, redo, canUndo/canRedo and undo/redo labels
tasks.dod: Vitest proves record appends and discards redoable entries (returning them as evicted), undo/redo move the cursor by one and return the state to restore, canUndo/canRedo are false at the ends, and undoLabel/redoLabel name the Step each would take back or restore

tasks.title: Bound the history: budget.ts with 50 Steps and 512 000 000 B, heldLayerBytes, and the oldest-first trim inside record
tasks.dod: Vitest proves 10 drawing Steps of 4096×3072 layers fit (503 316 480 B), an 11th drops the oldest, 50 Crop/Adjust Steps are all kept and a 51st drops the oldest, a shared layer counts once, the Work's own layer is not counted, and a 4096×4096 Work keeps 7

tasks.title: Add the edit-history composable, record a Step on every counting Apply, make withEdit take the revision, and move layer release to one path
tasks.dod: Vitest proves the AC-09 revision sequence and the reused-revision sequence through the composable, that only counting Applies record a Step (AC-06), that replace() starts an empty history and releases every old layer (AC-10), and that the bitmap ledger shows 0 retained layers after a discard (AC-04) — with withEdit requiring the revision and every existing test green

tasks.title: Expose undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo, undoTool, redoTool and historyStats on the editor store, with the refusals and the View fit
tasks.dod: Store tests prove the AC-03 Crop→Adjust→Draw sequence restores each state's very objects after three Undos and three Redos, undo/redo are refused (no change) while a tool is open, an export runs or the replace dialog is open, a size-changing Undo fits the View and a same-size one keeps it, and an ExportPanel test shows the size field following an Undo of a size-changing Crop

tasks.title: Move isTextTarget to src/shared/keyboard.ts so undo-redo can skip text and number fields
tasks.dod: src/shared/keyboard.ts exports isTextTarget with the same behaviour as draw's copy, re-exported from @/shared, and keyboard.test.ts covers text, number, textarea, select, contenteditable, checkbox/range and non-element targets

tasks.title: Add the undo-redo feature's messages and the pure shortcut handler for Ctrl/Cmd+Z, Shift+Ctrl/Cmd+Z and Ctrl+Y
tasks.dod: shortcuts.test.ts proves Undo on Ctrl+Z and Cmd+Z, Redo on Shift+Ctrl/Cmd+Z and Ctrl+Y but never Cmd+Y, no action in text fields or on repeats, the tool-open and export notices, nothing with no Work or with the replace dialog open, and preventDefault on handled keys

tasks.title: Build UndoRedoActions (two ghost BaseButtons with hints) and mount it first in the top bar with the shortcuts
tasks.dod: Component tests render SCR-01 default/can undo/can undo and redo/oldest reached, SCR-02, SCR-03 (aria-disabled + info toast on activate) and SCR-04 (truly disabled) with the catalog hints as title and aria-describedby, clicking Undo/Redo calls the store, and App.test shows UndoRedoActions right after "Open image" in the top bar

tasks.title: Expose the editor store's historyStats through window.__imglyTest for the e2e memory checks
tasks.dod: window.__imglyTest.historyStats() returns { heldBytes, steps } from the editor store in the hooks-enabled build, typed in e2e/test-hooks.d.ts, and pnpm typecheck passes for both

tasks.title: e2e (Chromium): the 512 MB budget, Steps kept and layer release after replace, discard and drop
tasks.dod: Chromium e2e proves heldBytes ≤ 512 000 000 and ≥ 10 Undos available after 100 full-image drawing Applies on the reference Work, whole-page memory after the 100th ≤ after the 10th + 10%, and 0 retained layers after replacing the Work, after a new Step discards redoable Steps, and after the oldest Steps are dropped (10 drawing Steps each)

tasks.title: e2e (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit): pixel-exact Undo and Redo for each tool, View fit, marks follow Geometry, shortcuts per engine
tasks.dod: e2e on all three engines proves a full-size PNG Export after Undo or Redo differs by 0 per channel from the Export of that state made before, for Steps of each tool (Straighten angle, all seven Adjustments off neutral, a drawing), the AC-12 fit/keep rule, the AC-13 marks-with-Geometry sequence, and that Ctrl/Cmd+Z, Shift+Ctrl/Cmd+Z and Ctrl+Y act while Cmd+Y is not handled

tasks.title: @perf e2e: Undo and Redo p95 ≤ 150 ms for a Step of each tool with a full-image drawing
tasks.dod: The @perf spec (PERF=1) measures 20 runs after 2 warm-ups from the shortcut keydown to the next presented Preview frame on the reference Work, for an Undo and a Redo of each tool's Step, and asserts p95 ≤ 150 ms
